root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `tune_look_behind()` rewrites a zero-length look-behind to empty, it must prove the look-behind body contains no `BAG_MEMORY` node marked by `NODE_IS_BACKREF` or `NODE_IS_CALLED`; otherwise the empty-reset path frees a capture subtree that is still referenced by a subexpression call.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original resets the second look-behind to empty even though its `()` capture node has already been marked called by `\g<1>`. The fixed program computes the same source-level usage predicate and blocks the reset when that predicate is true, leaving the later call-body walk with no stale alias to freed memory.

nodes.state: The empty-reset recursion reaches `onig_node_free(node)` on the same `BAG_MEMORY` heap node that `tune_call_node_call()` stored into `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)`.
The later `NODE_CALL` look-behind walk passes the freed `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` pointer back into `check_called_node_in_look_behind()`.
`check_called_node_in_look_behind()` reads `NODE_TYPE(node)` from the freed capture-group node, producing the saved AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read.

edges.relation: The exact heap node resolved into `NODE_CALL_BODY(cn)` is the node later freed by the empty-reset recursion.
After `onig_node_free(node)` releases the call-body target, the same pointer is still forwarded through the later `NODE_CALL` look-behind check.
The stale pointer passed from the `NODE_CALL` case becomes the `node` argument dereferenced by `check_called_node_in_look_behind()`.
